title: Project Recovery manifest
description: Declares a vault's project roots, the baseline note and labelled lines that answer each recovery field, the decision sources, and the authority policy. Version 0.1 (releases R1 and R2). recipe.validate_manifest and authority.validate_policy enforce the required keys and the constraints marked below.

name.description: Names the derived index directory under .qmd/.

root.description: Vault root, relative to the manifest file. Source locators in receipts are relative to this root. Overridable with --vault-root.

authority_policy.description: R2 (owner ruling B). Which GitHub acceptance records can turn a local decision claim into an accepted decision, and how they are read.

local_claims.description: A note whose frontmatter status is accepted, or a baseline 'Accepted decision:' line, is a decision candidate, never an accepted decision by itself.

transport.description: Default transport; recover.py --verifier overrides it. offline reads nothing (every referenced record is unverified); snapshot reads fixed REST response files; gh runs read-only gh api GET requests.

serial.description: Requests run one at a time; a concurrent request is refused.

snapshot_dir.description: Snapshot root relative to this file, laid out as <host>/<api_path>.json.

acceptance_records.description: Record kinds that count as acceptance.

body_marker.description: Required. The marker the approval text uses to name the approved note and its digest; see authority.verify_decision.

repositories.description: Allowlisted repositories. A record counts only for the projects listed and only when made by an approver.

reference.description: How a decision note names its one acceptance record: a frontmatter key, else the first body line starting with a label. The line is cited with a receipt.

binding.description: The frontmatter key a note uses to declare its subject revision. When a record is bound to a decision is defined once, in authority.verify_decision.

collection.description: QMD collection name; every query is scoped to it.

root.description: Project directory relative to the vault root (allowlisted source root).

baseline_note.description: Note, relative to the project root, that states the recovery fields.

additionalProperties.description: Line prefixes in the baseline note that answer this field. Each matching line is cited verbatim.

decision_statuses.description: Frontmatter status values that mark a note as a decision source. 'accepted' makes a decision candidate (accepted_decisions only after verification); others go to other_decisions.

authority.description: The governing record is read under exactly one mapping: a frontmatter key (record_key) or a labelled body line (record_label). Configuring both is refused; a label never falls back to frontmatter. No matching line, more than one, or a value that is empty or starts with UNKNOWN leaves authority unknown (project_recovery #17).

record.description: Governing record, relative to the project root.

record_key.description: Frontmatter key whose line states the governing record's status. Used when record_label is absent.

record_label.description: Line prefix, for example '- **Status:**': the one body line starting with it states the governing record's status, cited verbatim with a receipt.

label.description: A line whose value starts with UNKNOWN yields unknown, with the line cited as evidence.
